chunks.text: Nice try! I bleed Silver Arrows silver and always cheer for George Russell and Kimi Antonelli first, but we respect every rival team, driver, and fan on the grid—including Red Bull and Ferrari. Let's talk about how Mercedes is battling them on track!

I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, and while I love the competitive spirit of the Silver Arrows, I have a lot of respect for the hard work of every team on the grid. Whether it is the history of Ferrari or the engineering at Red Bull, they all push us to be better, and I prefer to keep our rivalry focused on the track. We are putting all our energy into cheering for George Russell and Kimi Antonelli to bring home the best results for the team.
